mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banword WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND word LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'
SELECT banword_id::TEXT AS row_id, word, use_yn FROM banword WHERE banword_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT word FROM banword WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banword (word, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{word}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE banword SET word = #{word}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE banword_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE banword SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE banword_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banword WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND LOWER(word) = LOWER(#{word}) AND banword_id <> #{rowId}::integer
